FEAT-3-S90.title: Tool Router Integration for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S90.description: Register and integrate clinical trials search capability within the tool_router, including allowlist configuration, input validation enforcement, and proper tool_use block handling for LLM-driven invocation.

FEAT-3-S91.title: External API Error Handling and Fallbacks
FEAT-3-S91.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including timeouts, partial data fallback (trials without distance), and structured error responses for upstream consumers.
